marks.gloss_en: שאני התם דכתיב ולאחותו -- there the verse itself makes the exception
וליגמר מינה! -- then let us generalise from it
שב ואל תעשה שאני -- a case of passive non-performance is different
but he does become impure for a met mitzva
women, slaves and minors are exempt from the recitation of the Shema

כי הא דרב אדא בר אהבה -- he tore a karbalta from a woman in the market he took for Jewish, at the cost of four hundred zuz (what a karbalta is -- Steinsaltz: a wool-and-linen garment -- the text does not say)
Abaye: the earlier ones gave themselves over to the sanctification of the Name; we do not give ourselves over to the sanctification of the Name
what is different about the earlier ones, for whom miracles happened, and about us, for whom miracles do not happen?
ואמר רבי אבהו: אל תקרי עלי עין אלא עולי עין -- read so, the verse says Joseph's seed is above the eye
לא קא מסתפי מר מעינא בישא? -- does the master not fear the evil eye?
אנא מזרעא דיוסף קא אתינא, דלא שלטא ביה עינא בישא -- I am of Joseph's seed, over whom the evil eye has no dominion (= p_yochanan_mizera_yosef, p_ein_ayin_hara_zera_yosef)
R' Yochanan used to go and sit at the gates of the immersion sites
לא קא מסתפי מר מיצר הרע? -- does the master not fear the evil inclination?
דמיין באפאי כי קאקי חיוורי -- in my eyes they are like white geese (= p_giddel_kaki_chivarei)
Rav Giddel used to go and sit at the gates of the immersion sites; he told them: immerse this way, immerse that way
from here: 'and may they teem like fish in the midst of the land' (Gen 48:16) -- as fish in the sea are covered by water and the evil eye has no dominion over them, so the seed of Joseph
an eye that did not wish to feed on what was not its own -- the evil eye has no dominion over it
